wed-lunch-flatbreads.title: Feta, tomato & tahini flatbreads
method: Warm the flatbreads briefly.
Loosen the tahini with lemon juice and 1–2 tbsp water until drizzleable.
Top with lettuce, halved tomatoes and feta; drizzle with tahini and olive oil, then add black pepper.
wed-lunch-flatbreads.flavourNote: The lemon must keep the tahini bright; feta supplies the salt.
wed-lunch-flatbreads.barneyNote: Cut into manageable strips or serve deconstructed; halve or quarter tomatoes lengthways.

wed-dinner-tagine.title: Slow-cooker beef & apricot Moroccan tagine with couscous, tenderstem & mangetout
method: Brown the beef in olive oil if time allows, then add it to the slow cooker.
Add sliced red onion, carrots, chopped tomatoes, apricots, tomato purée, garlic, stock and spices. Cook 7–8 hours on low or 4–5 hours on high until tender.
Steam the entire bag of tenderstem and the mangetout. Prepare couscous with boiling water according to the pack, then fluff with half the lemon juice.
Finish the tagine with the remaining lemon juice; taste and season the adult portions. Box two complete portions of tagine, couscous and greens before serving.
wed-dinner-tagine.flavourNote: Browned beef, toasted spices, apricot sweetness, tomato depth and lemon acidity should all be distinct; add black pepper and enough salt to the adults' servings.
wed-dinner-tagine.barneyNote: Chop beef and vegetables small; remove his portion before final adult seasoning.
wed-dinner-tagine.storageNote: Chill the two complete lunch portions promptly and reheat the tagine and couscous until piping hot.

arrangeForLunch.label: 2 complete adult portions for Thursday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve tagine, couscous, tenderstem and mangetout in each lunch box.

method: Reheat the complete tagine, couscous and vegetable portions until piping hot.

thu-dinner-rigatoni.title: Mustardy chicken, tomato & rigatoni bake with spinach and courgette
method: Heat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Cook the rigatoni 2 minutes short of the packet time.
Brown bite-size chicken in olive oil, then soften the onion and courgette. Add garlic and oregano.
Stir in passata, crème fraîche and mustard. Simmer until the chicken is cooked, add spinach to wilt, then combine with pasta and chopped vine tomatoes.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with Parmesan and bake 15–20 minutes until bubbling and browned. Box two complete portions before serving.
thu-dinner-rigatoni.flavourNote: Use the full mustard quantity, generous black pepper and browned Parmesan; taste the adult sauce for salt and acidity before baking.
thu-dinner-rigatoni.barneyNote: Remove his portion before extra salt; ensure chicken and courgette are soft and cut small.
thu-dinner-rigatoni.storageNote: Cool and chill two complete portions promptly; reheat once until piping hot.

arrangeForLunch.label: 2 complete adult portions for Friday lunch
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve complete portions containing chicken, rigatoni, sauce and vegetables.

fri-dinner-fajita-bowls.title: Smoky beef fajita rice bowls with sweetcorn, tomato, lettuce, feta & lime
method: Cook the rice. Sear the beef in batches over high heat with olive oil, cumin and smoked paprika; remove before it overcooks.
Char sliced peppers, onion and sweetcorn, then stir in garlic and tomato purée. Return the beef and finish with the juice of one lime.
Build every bowl with rice, beef and charred vegetables, chopped tomato, lettuce, feta and lime. Box two complete bowls, keeping lettuce and feta separate if preferred.
fri-dinner-fajita-bowls.flavourNote: Hard searing, properly cooked tomato purée and plenty of lime prevent a flat result; season adult servings assertively.
fri-dinner-fajita-bowls.barneyNote: Cook his beef tender and cut across the grain; keep spice mild and quarter tomatoes lengthways.
fri-dinner-fajita-bowls.storageNote: Chill lunch components promptly; keep lettuce/feta separate and reheat rice and beef until piping hot.

arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve all components: rice, beef, vegetables, tomato, lettuce, feta and lime.

sat-dinner-chicken-stew.title: Slow-cooker Moroccan chicken, chickpea & tomato stew with tahini-lemon rice
method: Add chicken, drained chickpeas, chopped tomatoes, carrots, courgette, onion, ginger, garlic, tomato purée, spices and olive oil to the slow cooker. Cook 6–7 hours on low or 3–4 hours on high.
Cook the rice. Loosen tahini with the lemon juice and 2–3 tbsp water.
Shred or slice the chicken, stir the stew and adjust adult seasoning. Serve every portion with rice and tahini-lemon drizzle; box two complete portions.
sat-dinner-chicken-stew.flavourNote: Ginger, garlic and spices need to be aromatic, while lemon-tahini adds richness and acidity. Salt adult servings only after Barney's is removed.
sat-dinner-chicken-stew.barneyNote: Mash some chickpeas and cut vegetables/chicken appropriately; serve tahini thinly mixed through if easier.
sat-dinner-chicken-stew.storageNote: Chill two complete stew-and-rice portions promptly; keep drizzle separate if preferred. Reheat thoroughly.

sun-dinner-greek-chicken.title: Greek lemon, garlic & oregano roast chicken with crispy potatoes, peppers, tomatoes & feta
method: Heat the oven to 210°C/190°C fan. Cut potatoes into small chunks, toss with half the oil and oregano, and roast for 20 minutes.
Add chicken, pepper and onion coated with remaining oil, garlic, lemon zest and oregano. Roast 25 minutes, then add tomatoes and cook until chicken is done and potatoes crisp.
Whisk lemon juice with mustard and the tray juices. Spoon over the adults' servings and crumble over feta.
sun-dinner-greek-chicken.flavourNote: Use deep roast colour, plenty of oregano and a sharp mustard-lemon dressing; feta brings salinity and richness.
sun-dinner-greek-chicken.barneyNote: Remove his portion before the sharper dressing and extra seasoning; cut chicken and vegetables appropriately.
sun-dinner-greek-chicken.storageNote: Refrigerate any unserved food within 2 hours.
